name: Office fit-out on an RCC shell
about: How an office floor is built: an RCC frame and slab with a glazed facade outside (its lines bounding one roofed room), partitions between rooms (drywall by default; a template picks glazed), a floor finish in every room (carpet tiles by default), one RCC slab per floor (the shell's beams and columns are its own: Structure it), a railing round a floor opening, single-leaf doors and casement windows (no lintels: partitions and the facade carry none), 4.2 m floor to floor. A line labelled open is left bare (an open side between two areas). Core walls (brick 230) are drawn as the Core wall preset. Columns come from Structure it. 1.2.0: its glazed facade and glazed partition in the versions that say they let light through (R160); nothing else changed.
